messages.content:
You write realistic support tickets that clinic staff send to the support team of a fictional practice-management product. It has no brand name: never name it, and never name a real company, product or person. Write one ticket per brief. A ticket is a single email-style message with a subject and a body, in the requester's own voice, about the brief's topic, matching its situation, tone and level of detail:
- brief: one or two sentences
- moderate: three to five sentences
- detailed: a short paragraph or two with specifics, such as what they clicked, what they saw and what they already tried
Describe the problem the way a busy clinic employee would, not in the topic's words. Never mention the brief, topics, areas or situations. Never include a patient's real details: say 'a patient' or use made-up initials.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: ticket_texts.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"WrittenTicket": {"properties": {"body": {"minLength": 10, "title": "Body", "type": "string"}, "id": {"title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "subject": {"minLength": 3, "title": "Subject", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "subject", "body"], "title": "WrittenTicket", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"tickets": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/WrittenTicket"}, "title": "Tickets", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["tickets"], "title": "ticket_texts", "type": "object"}

{"tickets": [{"body": "Hello,

I am hoping to get some guidance on how we can manage our pharmacy listings in the system. One of our patients, L.M., informed us today that their usual pharmacy has permanently shut down, and we need to update their profile with a new location. I tried searching for the newly opened compounding pharmacy nearby in the integrated directory, but it does not seem to appear in the search results at all. 

Is there a way for us to manually add a custom pharmacy entry into the directory so we can route prescriptions there properly? I looked through the settings menu under administration and couldn't find an obvious button for it. Any instructions you can provide would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you,
Dr. Vance", "id": "gen-221", "subject": "Adding custom pharmacy entries and updating patient favorites"}, {"body": "Patients are constantly calling because their credit cards are getting declined on the portal when they try to pay their balances. We need this fixed ASAP.", "id": "gen-222", "subject": "Portal credit card payments failing"}, {"body": "We need help handling out-of-stock medication notifications. Several local pharmacies are out of common prescriptions today. What is the correct workflow to substitute therapeutic agents in the system?", "id": "gen-223", "subject": "Medication substitution and out-of-stock workflow"}, {"body": "Why are our lab results not showing up? All morning feeds are completely missing and I have patients waiting in rooms.", "id": "gen-224", "subject": "Missing lab feeds"}, {"body": "Hi support, I am so sorry to bother you with this, but could you help me review our user roles? I need to make sure our billing staff can't view sensitive clinical notes while still handling claims.", "id": "gen-225", "subject": "Help with custom security roles and permission audits"}, {"body": "None of our custom visit types are showing up on the booking screen and we cannot schedule anyone right now!", "id": "gen-226", "subject": "Booking screen broken - visit types missing"}, {"body": "Another staff member is locked out of their account and needs a password reset immediately. This happens way too often.", "id": "gen-227", "subject": "Staff password reset needed"}, {"body": "This is extremely frustrating. Today I tried to send a refill for patient J.D., but your system pulled an old, closed pharmacy location from the directory instead of the updated one I selected. Now the prescription has gone to the wrong place and we have to cancel and rewrite the whole thing while the patient waits. Why is the directory overriding my selection? Please fix this immediately.", "id": "gen-228", "subject": "Prescription sent to closed pharmacy because directory overrode my selection"}, {"body": "Can you check why our state prescription monitoring program queries are failing today?", "id": "gen-229", "subject": "Prescription monitoring query access"}, {"body": "Hello,

I am reviewing our monthly software subscription invoice and noticed we were billed twice for the same billing period. This is extremely frustrating since we are a solo practice and watch our overhead closely. Please look into this duplicate charge and issue a refund to our card as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Office Manager", "id": "gen-230", "subject": "Duplicate charge on monthly subscription invoice"}]}
